data: What is the overall accuracy of the green line with 10,000 questions on the leftmost plot?

The question asks for the overall accuracy of the green line with 10,000 questions on the leftmost plot. The leftmost plot shows three lines representing different methods: Ours (green), LSTM (blue), and CNN+LSTM (yellow). The green line corresponds to the method labeled "Ours" in the table above the plots. The y-axis represents accuracy, and the x-axis represents the number of B Questions. At 10,000 questions, the green line reaches approximately 90% accuracy. Therefore, the overall accuracy of the green line with 10,000 questions is around 90%.
